title: Nonlinear physics of axion inflation
summary: An axion-like field coupled to an Abelian gauge field provides one of the simplest inflationary models that is free from the eta problem and possesses an efficient reheating mechanism. For sufficiently large coupling, this system enters a regime of strong gauge-field backreaction, exhibiting rich and intricate dynamics. In this work, we employ a semi-analytical method, the gradient-expansion formalism, to perform a comprehensive parameter scan and determine the precise conditions under which backreaction sets in.
